text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mihono Bourbon comes up to me while
I'm
walking down the hallway. It seems
she's still
fretting over the upcoming
party...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I was hoping to make a cyborg costume,
but there
is insufficient time.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I worry it won't be ready for the party at
my
current pace.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Something different? ...Indeed, that
would be a
wise course of action, given
the time remaining.
choice_data_list: 他の衣装を考えてみたら？
choice_data_list_en: Why not consider a different outfit?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
A costume that can be made quickly,
doesn't
require changing one's
expression, and is within
my
performance capabilities...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I will search using these criteria.
Commencing
mission.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
An animal that has the same expression
at all
times? Hm... How about a shoebill?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
I read in an encyclopedia that, while
shoebills do
have different expressions,
they don't move very
much, so it's hard
to make them out.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Oh, that's right! There's a fantasy novel
that has a
talking shoebill in it, and—

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I'm sorry. I almost started rambling
there...
It's a bad habit of mine.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Not at all. I appreciate your help.
Preparing to
input data on shoebills.
Could you tell me where
this
encyclopedia is located?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Retrieving information on shoebills from memory. The World's Most Peculiar Animals, page 36, figure 1.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
...Reproduction complete. What do you
think? I
would like your honest opinion.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I point out that even if Mihono
Bourbon's
expression doesn't change, it
doesn't mean she
has to keep her entire
body still.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Your response is logical. I predict that
remaining
perfectly still at the party will
dampen the mood
even more.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Removing shoebill costume from
potential
candidates. Resuming search
for an appropriate
costume.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Whaddya talkin' about? This isn't some
kinda
puzzle ya gotta solve. You just
gotta enjoy
yourself.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Besides, it's not like you're gonna find
anything
lookin' round here. Actually...
what about that
over there?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
But a carrot is very similar to a shoebill...
Strictly
speaking, a carrot moves even
less than a
shoebill.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Then why don't ya go as a leaf or
somethin'?
Y'know, just sway in the
breeze.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: I see. In that case...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
...Uhhh, you waitin' for me to say
somethin'?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mihono Bourbon continues her search
for
costume inspiration.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Costume candidates in school have been

exhausted. Locating potential costumes
is
proving difficult.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Earlier, Creek said I would be perfectly
fine as I
am. That even if I wore a
costume, I should be
myself.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
But any attempt to imitate something
will mean I
am not being "as I am."

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Something I'd like to be... A star fighter
zooming
through the cosmos, perhaps.
choice_data_list: 難しく考えず、なりたいものはないのか？
難しく考えず、なりたいものはないの？
choice_data_list_en: Without overthinking it, isn't there something you want to be?
Without overthinking it, isn't there something you want to be?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
No, that would be more difficult to
implement
than a cyborg. As far as
alternatives...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
A fast and strong Umamusume. That is
all that
comes to mind at present.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Perhaps I really am a boring person.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I'll think it over a little more... I must
complete
the mission I have been
assigned.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mihono Bourbon sets off walking with
her head
held high as if to psych herself
up. It looks like
she's not ready to give
up yet.
